body:
## Owner request

> Should we try GTK4?

Context: #570 browser memory/latency investigation; earlier owner question: “Also, have we tried different GSK renderers?” All user-agent comparisons so far use WebKit2.54.1's GTK3 build, not different engines.

## What exists today

`cloud-signin-window` depends on gtk3 and links gtk+-3.0 / webkit2gtk-4.1. WebKit recipe explicitly sets USE_GTK4=OFF. No GTK4/Graphene recipe or ready host GTK4/WebKit6 development pair was found. GSK_RENDERER does not select a backend for this GTK3 application. Existing WebKit DMA-BUF/Panfrost trials remain relevant but inconclusive; changing GTK must not be represented as an already-proved fix.

Source migration work includes GTK containers/packing, draw callback, lifecycle/event controllers, on-screen keyboard's fabricated GDK events, style/display APIs, and related auth views. WebKit6 requires new construction/network-session APIs; preserve ephemeral sessions, related-view state, host restrictions and completion. Review process-swap and sandbox requirements in the exact target version. Current recipe disables the sampling profiler too, which must be considered when designing JS attribution tests.

Upstream check October13: https://github.com/WebKit/WebKit/blob/main/Source/WebKit/gtk/migrating-to-webkitgtk-6.0.md , https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/migrating-3to4.html , https://www.webkitgtk.org/2026/09/16/webkitgtk-2.54-highlights.html . WebKit6 is the GTK4 API, not WebKit engine version6. GTK4 can alter toolkit rendering/frame integration, while WebKit/JavaScriptCore still runs provider code. No matching incident-specific GTK4 fix established.

## Ordered investigation

Subtask of #570, within M7.P5: CSS-width controls are complete and retired. At the owner's invitation, source-only GTK4 feasibility now runs in parallel with script/CPU/reclaim attribution and safe service-footprint preparation. Actual renderer/runtime trials remain serialized under the coordinator. Keep engine version and non-GTK options matched where supported; document unavoidable changes instead of claiming a pure single-variable comparison. #493 lifecycle/capacity enforcement precedes any new full cache copy/build. Use an isolated feature/build checkout; accepted GTK3 cache/artifact stays immutable. A smaller successful #570 fix can make migration unnecessary for this RC; this is an evidence-based adopt/defer decision, not an unconditional distro-wide GTK migration.

## Agent-verifiable acceptance

Can this be done on the VM? **Yes** for dependency/compile/functional/memory experiments. H700-specific GPU buffers and hardware recovery require only the existing named browser-bench scope after VM success.

- [ ] Dependency/API inventory binds exact GTK4 and WebKit source versions, patches, build flags, new runtime requirements and required source adaptations; includes the same-version GTK3 control and dated upstream check.
- [ ] Isolated build proof (or concrete bounded feasibility failure) retains pkgcheck/build/installed dependency outputs, watcher completion channels and capacity/retention receipt; no accepted artifact overwritten.
- [ ] If runnable, benchmark actual supported GSK renderers with observed renderer/driver evidence, matched UA/CSS viewport/engine/content controls, PSS/CPU/reclaim/input latency and native frames. Record unsupported/guard-truncated outcomes honestly.
- [ ] VM synthetic auth flow verifies on-screen keyboard, phone input ordering, pad exit, page navigation, popup return, localhost callback and ephemeral-state disposal, with exact-source flow/frame index. No owner account needed.
- [ ] Written adopt/defer decision cites measured responsiveness/memory/recovery and compatibility outcomes. Any proposed production change completes ordinary clean/retained VM, code-audit and physical-fact gates before candidate promotion; an unsuccessful experiment does not force migration.

Current worker: pix-gtk4, Herdr w4:p7, feature/m7-gtk4-576 at /workspace/repos/rocknix.worktrees/m7-gtk4-576. Working activity observed after explicit scoped dispatch. No GTK4 compile/runtime result exists yet; do not infer closure from lane creation.
title: M7.P5: Evaluate GTK4 sign-in rendering for browser pressure
